# Helm of the Forgotten King 

## Description 

A black steel crown-helm engraved with names that disappear when read. 

## Powers 

* Once per day, the wearer may issue a Royal Command. 

* Any creature of 5 HD or less within 30 feet must save vs. Spell or obey a
simple command for 1 round. 

* The wearer gains a +2 bonus to reaction rolls and Leadership-related
encounters. 

* Immune to fear generated by undead. 

## Hidden Power 

If worn while seated on an actual throne, the helm allows communication with the
spirits of past rulers who once held authority over the region. 

## Drawback 

The wearer gradually develops the personality traits of ancient monarchs. After
every month of use, make a Wisdom check. Failure adds a quirk such as pride,
suspicion, or obsession with lineage.

4000XP
